basis: Rows are the 31 video models (167 tiers) of the pricebook, read from its rendered table; each model's tier count equals the offerCount in the page's JSON-LD. Prices are gross USD per output second, before MachGen's Generation Credit. A display name maps to its API id through the JSON-LD sku, the row's 'API model:' label, or the models table (Wan 2.2 A14B (I2V) and (T2V) are both Wan2.2-A14B).
rules: Duration bands are graduated: each band's rate applies to the seconds inside it. Vidu Q3 Turbo 540p shows 0.015, 0.018 and 0.02 USD/s for 1-5, 6-10 and 11-16 s, and its examples are 0.075 for 5 s, 0.165 for 10 s (5 x 0.015 + 5 x 0.018) and 0.285 for 16 s; a flat band rate would give 0.18 and 0.32.
The table rounds rates to three decimals: MiniMax H3's 480p 16-30 s row shows 0.018 USD/s, and its 30 s example of 0.787 USD (15 x 0.035 + 15 x 0.0175 = 0.7875) pins 0.0175.

MiniMax H3 Turbo is at a limited-time promotional rate: 0.01 USD/s is billed now, 0.02 USD/s is the struck-through list price. The JSON-LD sku is MiniMax-H3-MultiMax; the row's label and the models table give the API id MiniMax-H3-Turbo.
LTX 2.3 Pro's 540p and 720p tiers are on the pricebook, but the API accepts only heights 1080, 1440 and 2160 (machgen-grids-2026-10-25.json).
Kling Video 4.0 is on the pricebook (JSON-LD sku Kling-v4) and pricing.txt, but not in the models table; the capability contract marks it private, so it is not priced here.

Rates were cross-checked against GET https://api.machgen.ai/api/v0/billing/pricebook/public (machgen-pricebook-2026-10-25.json): 165 of 167 rows match exactly; the other two are the MiniMax H3 480p 16-30 s display rounding above.

Input-video rows bill input plus output seconds; the input is what MachGen reads after reference_video_start_secs (MiniMax-H3-Turbo: a 4 s clip read from 1 s with a 4 s output billed 70000 micros = 7 x 0.01). A model without input-video rows bills its one rate on both: Alibaba-Wan-3.0 at 480p, a 4 s reference and 2 s out, billed 294000 micros = 6 x 0.049. An edit renders its source's length (Seedance-2.5: 4 s source, 480000 micros = 8 x 0.06). Audio references do not bill (MiniMax-H3: audio-only 1 s, 50000 micros).
MiniMax H3's upscale bills input plus output seconds, and its output runs the source's length: a 5 s 768p source upscaled to 1440p billed 500000 micros = 10 x 0.05.

MiniMax H3 bills an I2V request with an end frame at its Image to Video rate: a 2 s 480p request with two src_image_urls billed 70000 micros (0.035 USD/s), not the Reference to Video / Frame to Frame rate of 0.05 USD/s (tests/recordings/machgen_3663587242/minimax-h3-i2v-end-frame-2s_*). The Frame to Frame rows are priced here for R2V only.

Every model with duration bands, audio tiers or an alias, and every R2V and UPSCALE price added for ac-ks4no2, was checked against a billed receipt: 46 tasks recorded on 2026-10-25 billed exactly their estimate (22 for ac-fs70lj; 21 for ac-ks4no2, in tests/machgen-helpers.ts MACHGEN_RECORDED plus the MiniMax-H3 upscale and its source; 3 for ac-5qfga3, one T2V clip per T2V-only model), and the ac-ks4no2 Topaz upscale billed exactly MachGen's quote.
